maturityAmount() returning principal + interest.
Create three subclasses, each of which overrides rate() only:
SavingsAccount — 4 percent per year.
FixedDeposit — 7 percent per year.
RecurringDeposit — 6 percent per year.
Read the account type, the principal and the number of years, then print the interest and the maturity amount.

Token 1: the account type, exactly one of SAVINGS, FIXED or RECURRING.

Line 1: Interest = <value>
Line 2: Maturity Amount = <value>
Both values printed with exactly two decimal places.

1000.0 ≤ principal ≤ 10000000.0
1 ≤ years ≤ 20
